author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: an open-bottomed three-bump cloud over a long mist line and a lower broken mist line offset right; matches the reference. The rejected drawing had a curled, unclear cloud and only two plain bars.
omissions: The reference's fourth small bump on the cloud's right is merged into one right bump.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L; cloud bezier from (6,23) through cusps (13,15), top (23,8), (33,15) to (42,23); mist lines y 32 (x 4..30) and y 40 (x 14..28, 36..44).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'cloud-fog': open cloud over horizontal mist lines.
